description: CoreSpec Mapper V5.1 runtime expert configuration with 24 runnable SWIR targets and explicit experimental phase gates.

rgb_nir_fe_oxide.limitation: The field NIR starts at 691 nm and RGB is not a calibrated hyperspectral VNIR observation, so hematite-goethite separation is not implemented.

tir_emissivity.limitation: No TIR sensor or compatible emissivity reference collection is available.

white_mica_illite.display_name: White Mica–Illite Competition and Al-OH Subtypes

subtype_axis.interpretation: The subtype is a spectral-composition descriptor and must not be presented as certain illite-versus-muscovite phase separation.

illite.phase_discrimination_note: Illite versus muscovite remains conditional; always report the Al-OH wavelength subtype and competition margin.

muscovite.phase_discrimination_note: Experimental phase label; the Al-OH wavelength subtype is the more defensible compositional output.

hematite.limitation: Mineral-level recognition is disabled; current data can provide only auxiliary iron-oxide-family evidence.

goethite.limitation: Mineral-level recognition is disabled; current data can provide only auxiliary iron-oxide-family evidence.

quartz.limitation: Recognition is disabled because there is no TIR sensor and no compatible emissivity reference set.

tremolite.phase_discrimination_note: Experimental conditional split from actinolite; require a strong competition margin and geological review.

actinolite.phase_discrimination_note: Experimental conditional split from tremolite; require a strong competition margin and geological review.

biotite.phase_discrimination_note: Weak SWIR features require reference consensus and geological review.

siderite.phase_discrimination_note: The 2.33 µm carbonate feature overlaps calcite; phase output is conditional on full-shape competition.
